description: Image Caption: Judy Sherman Shifting Realities New Years Art Jamboree! FREE | Friday, January 2 | 11:00 AM – 1:00 PM Homeroom Galleries | 50 Victoria Street, Aurora Start your new year artsy with Eva Folks and Judy Sherman through an interactive workshop right in Homeroom Galleries, next to their paintings on view. All ages welcome (children require adult supervision) to this free drop-in workshop. Space is limited, participation is first come, first serve. Learn more about the exhibition →
